neighbours.label: a relation word that expects an amount next: threshold words before a number ('below', 'approaches', '<') and 'waste of' before time or money
fire: The river level fell below 3 meters during the drought.
The crowd at the stadium now approaches 60,000 fans.
Average wages climbed above 30 dollars an hour.
Everyone agreed the whole meeting was a waste of time.
Buying that extended warranty is a complete waste of cash.
Annual losses at the firm now approach 9 million.
The snow melts once the air warms above 2 degrees.
quiet: The river level fell slowly during the long drought.
The crowd at the stadium sang loudly for the fans.
Average wages climbed steadily across the whole state.
Everyone agreed the whole meeting was a lot of fun.
Buying that extended warranty is a complete mistake.
Annual losses at the firm worried the new owners.
The snow melts once the air warms in the spring.

notes: ' of' is the commonest top token; probes put it high only in 'waste of' and 'use of', not in 'cup of'.
